verdict.rationale: LaunchDarkly has a first-party doc titled "Individual targeting" and related docs on targeting with flags, contexts and segments, so targeting specific users on a flag is a documented capability. Segments add a reusable way to group cohorts such as beta testers or internal accounts. The evidence is mostly page titles with little detail, and community evidence only mentions rule- and group-level targeting. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of excluding specific individuals, detail on allowlist and segment behaviour, and independent or hands-on corroboration of individual-level targeting.
